I admitted my elder brother to Jagriti Rehabilitation Centre, Taloja Branch, hoping he would receive proper care and support. Unfortunately, on 6th June, we received the shocking news that he had passed away at the age of just 30.
As per the centre, my brother was found unconscious in the washroom around 8:30 AM and was admitted to the hospital around 1:00 PM. However, we still do not know what happened during those crucial hours. Despite repeated attempts by our family and even his treating doctor, Dr. Ayushi, to obtain his medical history and understand the situation, the staff did not respond to calls or provide clear information.
After my brother's death, we requested CCTV footage from the area where he was staying so that we could understand what actually happened. Unfortunately, our requests have been ignored. What has hurt us even more is the rude and insensitive behavior we have faced while seeking answers about our brother's final hours.
We entrusted Jagriti Rehabilitation Centre with my brother's care, believing he would recover and return home safely. Instead, we lost him forever, and we are still left without proper explanations or transparency.

Use: "I felt deeply terrified when you missed your medical checkup last Tuesday because of alcohol."
